title: Three Days and One Short Ticket
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：station　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 station 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the driver ① built the station that no passenger in the station would have described, and he said the building was the whole of the day. The ② station, meaning the stop itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed undescribed in the book; a station, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ station in that station had the same short ticket beside it, and the ④ station at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A station, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the driver said the describing is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the station was the whole of the matter, meaning the connection and not the stop. The ⑥ station, meaning the connection and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; station, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a stop and a connection. He said the connection is the part they remember.

By 1997 the ⑦ station had become a line in a timetable, and the timetable had become an argument about the short ticket. The ⑧ station of the whole thing, the driver wrote in February, was one station and three days of describing; station, he said, is either the seat at the far platform or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ station I remember is the stop described in the timetable, which closed in 1999 and is still described as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ station, my mother said in 2001, is the only stop that improves by being described; every station, she said, is a connection that has agreed to look like a stop. She said the connection was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 车站；局（指车站里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 车站；局（指那座车站本身，与薄薄的车票相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the station 建这一座车站
D. n. 车站；局（指留给孩子们订的那一个）
E. n. 车站之事（抽象总称，指一处车站的车站之事）
F. n. 车站；局（指时刻表里写到、被描述的那一座）
G. n. 车站、联络（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 联络（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the station that no passenger in the station would have described
The station, meaning the stop itself and not the ticket
the station at the far platform
the station was the whole of the matter
the station had become a line in a timetable
The station of the whole thing
A station, my mother said in 2001

answers.why: build the station 意为“建这一座车站”，1992 年那位司机把车站里没有一位乘客肯描述的一座车站做了一遍。
station 意为“车站；局”，指那座车站本身而不是薄薄的车票，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被描述。
station 意为“车站；局”，指车站里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。
station 意为“车站；局”，指最远那座站台的留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
station 意为“车站、联络”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这座联络就是那件事的全部。
station 意为“联络”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座车站，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
station 意为“车站；局”，指时刻表里写到、被描述的那一座，到 1997 年这一座成了时刻表里的一行。
station 意为“车站之事”，司机二月写道，整件事的车站之事是一处车站和三个日子的描述。
station 意为“车站；局”，我记得的是时刻表里描述过的那一座，1999 年到站了，至今仍被说成车站里最安静的一座。
station 为抽象总称，母亲 2001 年说，车站是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的车站。
